chunks: Until they see what they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in aid and fewer in number.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'who is weaker in aid and fewer in number'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Jinn underscores the ultimate futility of worldly powers and false allies when divine decree is realized, serving as a warning to those who rely on numerical strength or political alliances rather than God. It highlights the irony that the very group expecting victory will find their 'supporters' and 'numbers' insufficient against the true power of Allah, a theme resonating with the concept of *Batu'l-Haqq* (holding fast to truth) amidst societal shifts.
